messages:
Megan L.: Lost my physical insurance card while traveling in Mexico. Went to a local urgent care for a cut — paid out of pocket. Who's the right contact to get a temporary proof of coverage / digital card and start a claim? The clinic needs a member ID.

Aisha (People Ops): Oh no! Okay first: you can pull a digital ID from the carrier app/portal. Carrier is Blue Cross Blue Shield (BCBS). If you don't have portal access, we can request a temporary confirmation letter from the carrier.

Megan L.: I don't have the member ID saved — only my SSN on file. I can upload the receipt if needed.

Jorge (Benefits): If it's an emergency/urgent visit abroad BCBS's international emergency coverage usually applies. Steps: 1) get an itemized bill (superbill) with CPT/diagnosis and provider NPI; 2) scan front/back of the receipt; 3) submit a paper claim to BCBS international claims (phone: +1-877-555-0199) or use the mobile app -> Claims -> File a Claim; 4) keep provider contact info and passport stamp as backup.

Megan L.: Clinic charged USD 420. Can Redwood advance anything while claim processes?

Aisha (People Ops): We can consider a temporary hardship reimbursement for >$1,000; otherwise wait for the carrier EOB. Send the receipt and itemized invoice to benefits@redwood-inference.com and cc me. We'll open an internal case and track the carrier response.

Lucas: Tip — ask the clinic for a 'superbill'. BCBS needs line items to adjudicate out-of-network claims, otherwise they'll deny for insufficient detail.

BenefitsBot: Reminder — Typical carrier turnaround: 7–21 business days after they receive a complete claim + docs. Out-of-network claims reimburse at allowed amount minus deductible & coinsurance.

Megan L.: What exactly should I fill out on the claim form? Any quick template?

Jorge (Benefits): Minimal required fields: member name, DOB, member ID (if unknown put SSN and we'll attach enrollment proof), provider name/address, date of service, CPT codes or clear description, total charged, payments made. Paste this into the carrier portal or onto the paper form:

``
Member: Megan L. (DOB: 1992-04-02)
Member ID: [leave blank if unknown]
SSN on file: 123-XX-6789
Date of service: 2026-03-20
Provider: Clinica San Rafael / Dr. Alberto Ruiz / NPI: 1234567890
Diagnosis/Procedure: laceration repair (CPT 12001)
Total charged: $420.00
Paid by member: $420.00
Attachments: itemized receipt, provider license, passport stamp
``

Aisha (People Ops): When you submit, screenshot the confirmation and paste it here. We'll escalate to the carrier if the EOB doesn't arrive in 14 business days.

Megan L.: Thanks — sending docs now. Also how do I get a replacement physical card shipped to a US address?

Aisha (People Ops): On the BCBS portal choose 'Request ID Card' -> shipping address: enter your US mailbox or parent's address. If you want us to request expedited shipping from HR, give the ship-to address and we'll log it with the carrier.

Megan L.: Please expedite to my parents' address: 123 Maple Ave, Palo Alto, CA. Appreciate it. :pray:

Jorge (Benefits): Noted. Logged a carrier case on your behalf (case #BCBS-62618). Expect confirmation via SMS/email. If you'd like the claim template as a doc, I can DM you.

Aisha (People Ops): Tagging @benefits if any follow-up. :thumbsup:

Megan L.: Uploaded scans and the clinic superbill to benefits@redwood-inference.com and pasted the confirmation code here. Thanks everyone!

(React: :white_check_mark: from Aisha, :eyes: from Jorge)
